dialogues.jp: いつもの昼休み時間、なのだが……。
dialogues.en: Lunchtime like normal, except not...
dialogues.text: Lunchtime like normal, except not...

dialogues.jp:
さすが試験期間中なだけあって、たいがいの学
生は昼食をとりながらもノートや参考書に目を
落としている。
dialogues.en:
As expected for the examination periods, most of the
students were eating with their nose buried inside their
textbooks.
dialogues.text:
As expected for the examination periods, most of the
students were eating with their nose buried inside their
textbooks.

dialogues.jp: 「みんな、大変だよな」
dialogues.en: "How awful for them."
dialogues.text: "How awful for them."

dialogues.jp:
もふもふとパンを頬張りつつ、そんな教室内の
様子を眺める俺。
dialogues.en:
I surveyed the surroundings around me, calmly chewing on my
bread,
dialogues.text:
I surveyed the surroundings around me, calmly chewing on my
bread,

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにを人ごとみたいに言ってるんですか」
dialogues.en: "You're not one to talk about other peole."
dialogues.text: "You're not one to talk about other peole."

dialogues.jp: 溜息まじりに音夢がつぶやく。
dialogues.en: Nemu glanced at me from the side and sighed.
dialogues.text: Nemu glanced at me from the side and sighed.

dialogues.jp:
「いや……もうここまで来たらあとは天命に任
　せるっきゃないと思ってな」
dialogues.en: "Nah... I leave the rest up to God's hands."
dialogues.text: "Nah... I leave the rest up to God's hands."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう、その前に少しは自分の力でなんとかし
　ようと努力した方がいいですよ」
dialogues.en:
"You know, maybe you could try working harder to improve
yourself instead..."
dialogues.text:
"You know, maybe you could try working harder to improve
yourself instead..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: （そうは言っても………………）
dialogues.en: "(Even if you say that...)"
dialogues.text: "(Even if you say that...)"

dialogues.jp:
許せわが妹よ、残念ながら、自分の力でどうに
かできるという気がまったくしないのだ。
dialogues.en:
Forgive me, my sister, for I have already reached my limit
of improvement.
dialogues.text:
Forgive me, my sister, for I have already reached my limit
of improvement.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉……英語なんだけどさ、どのへんが出る
　と思う？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura... do you know what will be tested for the english
exams?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura... do you know what will be tested for the english
exams?"

dialogues.jp: と、教科書片手に工藤が尋ねてくる。
dialogues.en: With one hand holding a textbook, Kudou asked me a question.
dialogues.text: With one hand holding a textbook, Kudou asked me a question.

dialogues.jp:
「なんで俺んとこに！？　そういうことは杉並
　にでも聞けばいいだろ」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you asking me!? That kind of question is far more
suited to someone like Suginami."
dialogues.text:
"Why are you asking me!? That kind of question is far more
suited to someone like Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……あいつ、余裕こいて食堂行っちまったん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "...He went to the cafeteria."
dialogues.text: "...He went to the cafeteria."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「むぅ……肝心なときに使えん奴め……」
dialogues.en:
"Hmph... as usual, never there when you need him, but when
you don't..."
dialogues.text:
"Hmph... as usual, never there when you need him, but when
you don't..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はうめいて頭を抱えた。
dialogues.en: I put a hand to my forehead.
dialogues.text: I put a hand to my forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの……だいたいでよければ分かるよ」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... I'm pretty sure I have it somewhere."
dialogues.text: "Uhm... I'm pretty sure I have it somewhere."

dialogues.jp: 音夢がおずおずと口を挟んできた。
dialogues.en: Nemu timidly opened her mouth to speak.
dialogues.text: Nemu timidly opened her mouth to speak.

dialogues.jp:
「なにっ！？　音夢お前、そんな極秘情報をど
　こから手に入れた！？」
dialogues.en:
"What!? How on earth did you get hold of such top-secret
information, Nemu!?"
dialogues.text:
"What!? How on earth did you get hold of such top-secret
information, Nemu!?"

dialogues.jp: ｛にわ／俄｝かに身を乗り出した俺をじろっと｛にら／睨｝む音夢。
dialogues.en: In shock, I abruptedly turned my attention to Nemu.
dialogues.text: In shock, I abruptedly turned my attention to Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「『このへんは試験に出すからよく勉強しと
　け』って先生が言ってたじゃない！　もう
　……聞いてなかったんですね？」
dialogues.en:
"The teacher mentioned earlier about the subjects that were
going to come out on the test! Weren't you listening?"
dialogues.text:
"The teacher mentioned earlier about the subjects that were
going to come out on the test! Weren't you listening?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Uh, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, ahh..."

dialogues.jp: まったくもってその通りでございます。
dialogues.en: That was indeed the case, my lady.
dialogues.text: That was indeed the case, my lady.

dialogues.jp:
だらしない兄を詰問する調子に、ついたじたじ
となる。
dialogues.en: Her eyes bore down on me as the cross-examination continued.
dialogues.text: Her eyes bore down on me as the cross-examination continued.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめん、朝倉さん」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry, Asakura-san."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry, Asakura-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、工藤くんに言ったわけじゃないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that wasn't meant for you..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, that wasn't meant for you..."

dialogues.jp:
済まなそうにちぢこまる工藤に、音夢は慌てて
首を振った。
dialogues.en: At Kudou's apology, Nemu hastily shook her head.
dialogues.text: At Kudou's apology, Nemu hastily shook her head.

dialogues.jp:
「なんなんだ、その対応の違いは……授業を聞
　き逃してたのはコイツも同じだろうが」
dialogues.en:
"What's with the different reactions... he's the same as me
after all, someone who wasn't listening."
dialogues.text:
"What's with the different reactions... he's the same as me
after all, someone who wasn't listening."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「工藤くんはちゃんとテストを受ける気がある
　だけ、兄さんよりマシですからね」
dialogues.en: "At least he's actually attempting to study for it."
dialogues.text: "At least he's actually attempting to study for it."

dialogues.jp:
はっはっは、それを言われると、兄さん返す言
葉がないぞ。
dialogues.en: Ahahaha... I can't say anything in reply to that...
dialogues.text: Ahahaha... I can't say anything in reply to that...

dialogues.jp: 「……で、どこが出るって？」
dialogues.en: "...So, what will be tested?"
dialogues.text: "...So, what will be tested?"

dialogues.jp:
気を取り直して、蛍光ペンと教科書を机から引っ
張り出す。
dialogues.en:
Quickly regaining my composure, I whipped out my highlighter
and placed my textbook on my desk, ready for work.
dialogues.text:
Quickly regaining my composure, I whipped out my highlighter
and placed my textbook on my desk, ready for work.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「立ち直り早いなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Nice save..."
dialogues.text: "Nice save..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほらほら、ついでだから工藤も聞いとけ聞い
　とけ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, come on. Kudou wants to hear it, after all."
dialogues.text: "Come on, come on. Kudou wants to hear it, after all."

dialogues.jp: 俺はくいくいと工藤を手招きする。
dialogues.en: I beckoned to Kudou to say something.
dialogues.text: I beckoned to Kudou to say something.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Ah, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ahh..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ついでって……先に聞いたのは工藤くんで
　しょ？」
dialogues.en:
"So... I should only tell it to Kudou, since he's the only
one who asked, right?"
dialogues.text:
"So... I should only tell it to Kudou, since he's the only
one who asked, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁまぁ、かたいこと言わんと」
dialogues.en: "Oh don't mind me, I'm just a random passerby."
dialogues.text: "Oh don't mind me, I'm just a random passerby."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「しょうがないですね………………」
dialogues.en: "Whatever......"
dialogues.text: "Whatever......"

dialogues.jp:
音夢は、大きく溜息をつきながら教科書を開い
た。
dialogues.en: With a heavy sigh, Nemu opened her textbook.
dialogues.text: With a heavy sigh, Nemu opened her textbook.

dialogues.jp:
そうして、昼休みの時間は音夢教授の講義によっ
て費やされていったのだった。
dialogues.en:
And the rest of our lunch break was spent attending a
lecture from Professor Nemu.
dialogues.text:
And the rest of our lunch break was spent attending a
lecture from Professor Nemu.

dialogues.jp: ◆おしえて！　音夢教授♪◆
dialogues.en: ◆Teach me! Professor Nemu♪◆
dialogues.text: ◆Teach me! Professor Nemu♪◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、工藤に英語の出題範囲予想を聞かれた
がそのような事、俺が知るわけもない。
dialogues.en:
During lunch break, Kudou asked me about the scope of the
english exam, but I had no answer for him.
dialogues.text:
During lunch break, Kudou asked me about the scope of the
english exam, but I had no answer for him.

dialogues.jp:
結局、授業をちゃんと聴いていた音夢教授に、
講義をしてもらった俺たちだった。
dialogues.en: We ended up listening to Professor Nemu's lecture.
dialogues.text: We ended up listening to Professor Nemu's lecture.
